audit_items.proof_trace: V2 path correctly aborts on incomplete blob retrieval (L274-284), but V1 path (pre-PeerDAS) lacks this check. V1 publishes whatever blobs EL returns after deduplication (L224), violating the requirement that publishing must abort if not ALL blobs are retrieved.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker interferes with EL blob mempool. Block has N commitments, EL returns M < N blobs. V1 path publishes partial blob set to network without aborting, violating spec requirement for complete blob availability.
